QuestInfo.name: The Mayor of Disaster
QuestInfo.1: Masteria was ravaged by a vicious earthquake. Maple warriors from across the land are being asked to investigate the area for anything that could possibly cause such devastation.
QuestInfo.2: You decided to help #b#p9201050##k investigate the earthquake.

yes.0: The whole area around town is in shambles, and half of our town's residents are missing! It's all because of these earthquakes! We gotta get to the bottom of this!
